All 181 entries of the Java client API, grouped by object. Each
entry shows the signature from the client's own source, then the
matching CLI command and MCP tool where one exists.

Entries marked **(nightly)** are not in the latest release (26.8.21);
**(changed in nightly)** means the documented signature differs from that release.
Signatures come from the latest nightly build. See
[What's in Nightly](../../nightly.md). The same data for every surface
is in the [API matrix](../../reference/api-matrix.md) and in
[`/api.json`](/api.json).

Examples assume `bro` is a started browser and `vibe` is its page, as in the
[quickstart](index.md).

**`page.find(locator, options?)`**

Find a single element by description (a bare string), css, tag, semantic locator, or reference image; strategy auto, cv, vlm, or tree **(changed in nightly)**

- `public Element find(String description);`
- `public Element find(String description, FindOptions options);`
- `public Element find(SelectorOptions options);`

Find a single element by natural-language description, e.g. "the Add to Cart button". For an exact locator use `find(SelectorOptions)` with css, tag, role, text, or image.

Example: `Element button = vibe.find(new SelectorOptions().role("button").text("Submit"));`

CLI `vibium find <description>` · MCP `browser_find`

**`page.findAll(locator, options?)`**

Find all matching elements, same locator forms **(changed in nightly)**

- `public List<Element> findAll(String description);`
- `public List<Element> findAll(String description, FindOptions options);`
- `public List<Element> findAll(SelectorOptions options);`

Find all matching elements by CSS selector. Waits up to the timeout for at least one match, then returns an empty list if there is none. Each element carries a snapshot of its tag, text, and bounding box taken at findAll time, readable via `Element#info()` with no further round trips: els.stream().map(e -\> e.info().text()). Live reads like `Element#text()` re-resolve the element and fail if the page has changed since findAll.

Example: `List<Element> links = vibe.findAll(new SelectorOptions().role("link"));`

CLI `vibium find --all <description>` · MCP `browser_find_all`

**`page.route(pattern, handler)`**

Register a route handler

`public void route(String pattern, Consumer<Route> handler);`

Register a route handler for a URL pattern. The binary compiles the pattern, owns the intercept lifecycle, and annotates blocked request events with the patterns that matched, so dispatch never interprets the glob client-side.

## Route

**`route.request()`**

Access intercepted request

`public Request request();`

Get the intercepted request.

**`route.fulfill(options?)`**

Fulfill an intercepted request

- `public void fulfill();`

Fulfill the request with a custom response.

**`route.doContinue(options?)`**

Continue an intercepted request

- `public void doContinue();`
- `public void doContinue(ContinueOptions options);`

Continue the request (optionally with overrides). Named doContinue() because "continue" is a Java reserved word.

**`route.abort()`**

Abort an intercepted request

`public void abort();`

Abort the request.

## Download

**`download.saveAs(path)`**

Save a download to path

`public void saveAs(String path);`

Save the download to a path.

**`download.url()`**

Get download URL

`public String url();`

Get the download URL.

**`download.suggestedFilename()`**

Get download filename

`public String suggestedFilename();`

Get the suggested filename.

**`download.path()`**

Get download path

`public String path();`

Get the temp file path (waits for download to complete). Completion is awaited in the engine (vibium:download.await), which tracks every download by its navigation id, so this client keeps no pending-downloads map. Finished downloads answer immediately, so asking repeatedly is fine.

## Request

**`request.url()`**

Get request URL

`public String url();`

Get the request URL.

**`request.method()`**

Get HTTP method

`public String method();`

Get the HTTP method.

**`request.headers()`**

Get request headers

`public Map<String, String> headers();`

Get the request headers.

**`request.requestId()`**

Get BiDi request ID

`public String requestId();`

Get the request ID.

**`request.postData()`**

Get request body

`public String postData();`

Get the request body, or null when it is unavailable. Intercepted requests may not expose their body until they are continued, so this best-effort lookup is bounded to avoid blocking a route handler.

## WebSocketInfo

**`socket.url()`**

Get WebSocket URL

`public String url();`

Get the WebSocket URL.

**`socket.onMessage(fn)`**

Listen for messages

`public void onMessage(BiConsumer<String, String> callback);`

Listen for messages. The callback receives (data, direction) where direction is "sent" or "received".

**`socket.onClose(fn)`**

Listen for close

`public void onClose(BiConsumer<Integer, String> callback);`

Listen for close events. The callback receives (code, reason).

**`socket.isClosed()`**

Check whether socket is closed

`public boolean isClosed();`

Check if the WebSocket is closed.

## Run and Check

**`browser.check(claim, options?)`**

Independently verify the active session or a saved archive **(nightly)**

- `public CheckResult check(String claim);`
- `public CheckResult check(String claim, CheckOptions options);`

Verify the existing session with a fresh verifier inference context.

CLI `vibium check <claim>` · MCP `vibium_check`

**`page.check(claim, options?)`**

Independently verify a pinned page or a saved archive **(nightly)**

- `public CheckResult check(String claim);`
- `public CheckResult check(String claim, CheckOptions options);`

Verify the existing session with a fresh verifier inference context.

**`Vibium.check(claim, options)`**

Check a saved archive without launching a browser **(nightly)**

`public static com.vibium.types.CheckResult check(String claim, com.vibium.types.CheckOptions options);`

Inspect a saved recording without installing or starting a browser.

**`browser.run(goal, opts?)`**

Accomplish a goal in the active browser session **(nightly)**

- `public RunResult run(String goal);`
- `public RunResult run(String goal, RunOptions options);`

Accomplish a goal through the existing runtime in this live session.

CLI `vibium run <goal>` · MCP `vibium_run`

**`page.run(goal, opts?)`**

Accomplish a goal on a pinned page **(nightly)**

- `public RunResult run(String goal);`
- `public RunResult run(String goal, RunOptions options);`

Accomplish a goal through the existing runtime in this live session.
